seoTitle: Check Hostinger Expiry Date & Get 20% Renewal Coupon
metaDescription: Find your Hostinger hosting expiry date in the billing dashboard and learn how to apply a 20% off coupon for a cheaper renewal in 2026.
intro: Losing track of a Hostinger renewal date is an easy way to end up paying full price at the last minute, or worse, watching a site go dark because auto-renewal was switched off. Every subscription detail you need — expiration date, renewal cost, and whether it will renew automatically — lives in one panel inside your hPanel dashboard, just a couple of clicks from the sidebar. This guide walks through exactly where that panel is, what it tells you, and how to time a coupon so you're not paying the sticker price when it's time to renew.

steps.heading: Log into your Hostinger account
steps.body: Sign in at hostinger.com and you'll land in hPanel, Hostinger's account dashboard. The left-hand sidebar is your main navigation for the whole account — Home, Websites, Domains, Horizons, Emails, VPS, Dark web monitoring, and further down, Billing. If you manage more than one website or domain under the same account, hPanel groups everything by account rather than by site, so the billing information you're about to check covers every subscription tied to that login, not just one project.

steps.heading: Open Billing from the sidebar
steps.body: Scroll down the left sidebar until you reach the Billing icon and click it to expand the section, then choose Subscriptions. This is the page that lists every active service on the account — domains, hosting plans, VPS instances, add-ons — each as its own row. It's easy to miss on a first pass because it sits below more frequently used items like Websites and Domains, so if you don't see it immediately, keep scrolling rather than assuming it's somewhere else.

image.caption: The hPanel dashboard sidebar with Billing highlighted — the entry point for every subscription and renewal date on the account.

steps.heading: Click a subscription to see its expiration date
steps.body: The Subscriptions table shows each plan with a Subscription and Expiration date column, but clicking directly into one opens a fuller Subscription details panel on the right. In this example, a Cloud Startup plan shows Status as Active, an Expiration date of 2028-02-11, a Renewal price including tax, and a Subscription ID you can reference if you ever need to contact support about that specific plan. That expiration date is the number to write down or calendar — it's the exact day the clock runs out on that service.

image.caption: The Subscription details panel for a Cloud Startup plan, showing its expiration date, renewal price including tax, and auto-renewal status.

steps.heading: Check whether auto-renewal is on or off
steps.body: Just below the renewal price sits an Auto-renewal toggle, and it's worth checking every single subscription individually since Hostinger lets you set it per plan rather than account-wide. If it reads Off, as it does in this example, the plan will not renew by itself and you'll need to manually pay before the expiration date or the service lapses. If it's On, Hostinger will charge your saved payment method automatically, which is convenient but means you'll want to apply any coupon before that automatic charge fires, not after.

steps.heading: Look for a renewal coupon before you pay
steps.body: Hostinger periodically runs discount codes for renewals, including offers around 20% off, that get applied at the checkout or payment step rather than inside the subscription details panel itself. Check Hostinger's promotions page, any renewal reminder email they've sent you, or a current coupon aggregator before you proceed to payment, since these codes typically expire or rotate and aren't something the dashboard surfaces automatically. Having the code copied and ready before you start the renewal flow saves you from losing it partway through checkout.

steps.heading: Complete the renewal with the discount applied
steps.body: When you proceed to renew — either by disabling auto-renewal and paying manually or by renewing ahead of the automatic charge — there's a coupon or promo code field on the payment screen. Enter the code there, confirm the discounted total matches what you expected before submitting payment, and keep the receipt or confirmation email as your record. Renewing a few days ahead of the expiration date, rather than on the day itself, gives you a buffer if a coupon doesn't apply cleanly or a payment needs to be retried.

faq.question: Where do I find my Hostinger hosting expiry date?
faq.answer: Go to Billing → Subscriptions in the hPanel sidebar, then click into the specific plan. The Subscription details panel shows its exact Expiration date near the top.

faq.question: Can I get a discount on Hostinger renewal?
faq.answer: Yes, Hostinger runs renewal coupon codes periodically, including offers around 20% off. These are entered as a promo code at the payment step, not inside the subscription panel itself.

faq.question: Does this apply to VPS and cloud plans too?
faq.answer: Yes, the same Billing → Subscriptions page lists domains, shared hosting, cloud, and VPS plans together, each with its own expiration date and auto-renewal toggle.

faq.question: What happens if I miss my renewal date?
faq.answer: If auto-renewal is off and you miss the expiration date, the service can lapse, which may cause downtime. Checking the Auto-renewal status on each subscription tells you whether you need to act manually.

faq.question: Is auto-renewal set for my whole account or per plan?
faq.answer: It's per plan. Each subscription in the Billing section has its own Auto-renewal toggle, so it's worth checking every service individually rather than assuming they all match.
